'''Sully Stark''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] dissident of an [[Hidden Path|underground movement]] that helped smuggle surviving [[Jedi]] to safety.

==Biography==
[[File:MembersOfThePath-OWK.png|thumb|300px|left|Stark was part of planning the mission to rescue Princess Leia.]]
Sully Stark<ref name="Kenobi V">{{Kenobi|Part V}}</ref> joined [[Hidden Path|the Path]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] to help rescue and smuggle [[Jedi]] who survived [[Order 66]]. While [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was healing from his [[Battle on Mapuzo|battle]] against [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], she and [[Wade Resselian]] were discussing a plan to infiltrate the [[Inquisitorius]] [[Fortress Inquisitorius|fortress]] on [[Nur]] to rescue [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], though she admitted she did not know what the inside of the fortress was like. When Kenobi came out of the [[bacta tank]], he proposed using the [[T-47 airspeeder]]s, but Sully dismissed the idea, as they were only used for hauling sewage. Sully said that Kenobi was not fit enough to come on the rescue mission, as he was still recovering, but Kenobi insisted. [[Tala Durith]] let him accompany them on the mission, using her Imperial clearance to get inside the fortress.<ref name="Kenobi IV" />

Sully later piloted one of two T-47 airspeeders sent to help clear the platform and allow Kenobi, Durith, and Organa to evacuate the fortress. She witnessed Wade's airspeeder get destroyed by the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]], which devastated her.<ref name="Kenobi IV" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sully Stark was portrayed by actress [[Maya Erskine]], first appearing in "[[Part IV]]" in ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''.<ref name="Kenobi IV" /> The character's surname was provided in the credits for "[[Part V]]."<ref name="Kenobi V" />
